standing_principle: Across water rights, grid reliability, and managed retreat, the private-capital or market-based response consistently shows higher remediation confidence than the formal government policy process. Weight 'what capital is already doing' over 'what has been proposed' when scoring remediation confidence.

drivers.label: ENSO (El Nino / La Nina)
drivers.note: Original organizing frame for this build; now one input among several rather than the sole driver.

drivers.label: Secular warming
drivers.note: Heat-stress trends that persist independent of ENSO phase.

drivers.label: Wildfire / drought baseline
drivers.note: CA, Mediterranean, and Australia trending worse regardless of ENSO phase.

drivers.label: Water scarcity
drivers.remediation_confidence: low (policy) / higher where private capital is already deploying

drivers.label: Sea level / coastal
drivers.note: Slow-moving physically, but already repricing insurance and real estate markets.

drivers.label: Ecosystem service loss
drivers.note: Coral, fisheries, pollinators — thin, indirect investable link. Flag compounding factors explicitly rather than attributing causation to a single driver (e.g. pollinator decline is compounded by, not caused by, El Nino).

drivers.label: Water rights / compact disputes
drivers.note: Colorado River Compact is the active case study.

drivers.label: Grid reliability
drivers.note: Texas/ERCOT is the case study — battery storage buildout is the de facto fix, ahead of formal policy.

drivers.label: Logistics disruption
drivers.note: Trade policy currently outweighs climate as the primary disruption driver.

drivers.label: Managed retreat
drivers.note: The insurance market is the faster-moving, higher-confidence signal relative to formal retreat policy.

drivers.label: Critical minerals
drivers.note: China export controls; FORGE coalition and similar reshoring efforts.

drivers.label: Deep-sea mining
drivers.note: NOAA/DSHMRA permitting pathway moving faster than the stalled ISA Mining Code process.

drivers.label: Carbon border adjustment
drivers.note: EU CBAM is implemented; treat as a modifier on EU-exposed names, not a standalone thesis.
